title: AI Expense Categorizer & Spending Insights
description: Build a lightweight AI-powered expense management web application that categorizes expenses using machine learning and provides spending insights through an interactive dashboard.
final_objective: Develop a web application that accepts expense information, automatically categorizes expenses using a machine learning model, detects potentially unusual expenses, and presents spending insights through an interactive dashboard.

project.title: AI Expense Categorizer & Spending Insights
project.description: Create a Flask-based expense management application that uses machine learning to automatically categorize expense descriptions and provides visual spending insights.

milestones.title: Expense Management Flask Application
milestones.objective: Build the initial working Flask application where users can add expenses and view them through a browser-based dashboard.

tasks.task: Create a Flask project with separate folders for routes, templates, static files, database handling, and machine learning components.
tasks.expected_output: The Flask application starts successfully and has a clean project structure.

tasks.task: Create a responsive expense entry page containing fields for expense description, amount, date, and payment method.
tasks.expected_output: Users can enter expense information through a browser form.

tasks.task: Create a database table for storing expenses and implement functionality to save submitted expense records.
tasks.expected_output: Submitted expenses are stored and can be retrieved.

tasks.task: Create an expense history page displaying all entered expenses in a structured table.
tasks.expected_output: Users can view previously entered expenses.

tasks.task: Create a basic dashboard displaying total expenses, number of transactions, and total spending for the selected period.
tasks.expected_output: The application displays basic spending statistics.

tasks.task: Add input validation for missing descriptions, invalid amounts, and invalid dates.
tasks.expected_output: Invalid expense entries are rejected with clear messages.

milestones.demo_output: Start the Flask application, open localhost, add multiple expenses, open the expense history, and demonstrate the dashboard updating the total spending and transaction count.
milestones.github_requirement: Push the complete Week 1 implementation to GitHub with setup instructions.
milestones.completion_condition: The employee can enter expenses through the browser, store them in the database, view expense history, and see basic spending statistics.

milestones.title: Machine Learning Expense Categorization
milestones.objective: Train and integrate a machine learning model that automatically predicts the category of an expense from its description.

tasks.task: Create a small labeled expense dataset containing descriptions and categories such as Food, Transport, Shopping, Bills, Entertainment, Health, Education, and Other.
tasks.expected_output: A labeled dataset is available for model training.

tasks.task: Clean and preprocess the expense descriptions for machine learning.
tasks.expected_output: Expense descriptions are converted into suitable training text.

tasks.task: Convert expense descriptions into numerical features using TF-IDF.
tasks.expected_output: Expense descriptions are represented as machine learning features.

tasks.task: Train a lightweight classification model such as Logistic Regression or Linear SVM to predict expense categories.
tasks.expected_output: A trained expense-category classification model is available.

tasks.task: Evaluate the model using accuracy and a classification report.
tasks.expected_output: The employee can demonstrate basic model performance.

tasks.task: Integrate the trained model into the Flask application so that a newly entered expense automatically receives a predicted category.
tasks.expected_output: New expenses receive an ML-generated category.

milestones.demo_output: Enter expenses such as 'pizza dinner', 'Uber ride to college', 'Amazon headphones', and 'electricity bill' and demonstrate the application automatically assigning appropriate categories.
milestones.github_requirement: Push the dataset, model-training code, trained model, evaluation results, and Flask integration.
milestones.completion_condition: The Flask application automatically predicts a category for newly entered expenses using the trained machine learning model.

milestones.title: Spending Analytics and Unusual Expense Detection
milestones.objective: Transform categorized expenses into useful visual analytics and implement a basic machine learning-based mechanism for identifying unusually high expenses.

tasks.task: Create a spending analytics page showing total spending by expense category.
tasks.expected_output: Users can view category-wise spending.

tasks.task: Create charts showing spending distribution across categories using a suitable visualization library.
tasks.expected_output: Expense categories are represented visually.

tasks.task: Create a monthly or date-based spending chart showing how expenses change over time.
tasks.expected_output: Users can visually inspect spending trends.

tasks.task: Implement a basic unusual-expense detection mechanism using a statistical or unsupervised machine learning technique such as z-score or Isolation Forest.
tasks.expected_output: Potentially unusual expense records can be identified.

tasks.task: Display detected unusual expenses separately with the expense description, amount, category, and reason for being flagged.
tasks.expected_output: Users can understand which expenses were flagged.

tasks.task: Add filters for category and date range to the analytics dashboard.
tasks.expected_output: Users can interactively filter the spending analysis.

milestones.demo_output: Add several expenses, open the analytics dashboard, filter expenses by category/date, display spending charts, and demonstrate an unusually high expense being flagged.
milestones.github_requirement: Push the analytics dashboard, visualization code, and unusual-expense detection implementation.
milestones.completion_condition: The application displays interactive spending analytics and identifies potentially unusual expenses.

milestones.title: Complete AI Expense Intelligence Dashboard
milestones.objective: Integrate all previous features into one polished application and complete testing, error handling, and documentation.

tasks.task: Integrate expense entry, ML categorization, expense history, analytics, and unusual-expense detection into one consistent application workflow.
tasks.expected_output: All major features work together.

tasks.task: Update the main dashboard to display total spending, transaction count, top spending category, recent expenses, and unusual expenses.
tasks.expected_output: The main dashboard provides a complete spending overview.

tasks.task: Allow users to open an individual expense and view its description, amount, predicted category, date, and unusual-expense status.
tasks.expected_output: Individual expense details are accessible.

tasks.task: Add appropriate error handling for database failures, invalid input, missing data, and machine learning prediction failures.
tasks.expected_output: The application handles common errors without crashing.

tasks.task: Improve the user interface, navigation, empty states, loading states, charts, and result presentation.
tasks.expected_output: The application has a consistent and professional interface.

tasks.task: Create a complete README containing installation instructions, database setup, model-training instructions, project architecture, technologies used, and demonstration instructions.
tasks.expected_output: Another developer can install and understand the project.

tasks.task: Perform an end-to-end demonstration starting from entering an expense and ending with ML categorization, analytics, and unusual-expense detection.
tasks.expected_output: A complete final project demonstration video.

milestones.demo_output: Run the complete Flask application and demonstrate adding expenses, automatic ML categorization, expense history, spending analytics, unusual-expense detection, and the final dashboard.
milestones.github_requirement: Push the final stable project to GitHub with complete README documentation.
milestones.completion_condition: The complete AI Expense Categorizer & Spending Insights application works end-to-end and can be demonstrated successfully from localhost.
